integrity.consistency: One theorem and its corollaries are stated consistently across accompanying files.
integrity.object: Clique bouquets formed by joining a hub to disjoint cliques.
integrity.proof: Classification of all nonempty inclusion-minimal skew forts, then transversal counting and extremal deductions.

scientific_limitations: Results assume at least two peripheral cliques, each containing at least two vertices.
No assertion is made for general block graphs or singleton peripheral blades.
Bibliographic novelty has not been independently validated; equivalent unpublished or unindexed results remain possible.
Exhaustive finite tests are corroborative rather than proofs of the infinite-family theorem.
title: Skew-zero-forcing polynomials and uniform forcing spans of clique bouquets
